attributes.name: form control semantics
attributes.definition: Whether forms and actions use native HTML elements (real buttons, labelled inputs, native selects) versus generic or custom-built substitutes.

values.value: native form elements with explicit labels
values.definition: Inputs use real label elements and native controls (select, date, radio, input), tied to labels.
Controls are built from non-semantic elements or custom widgets lacking native semantics.

attributes.name: action element semantics
attributes.definition: The element type used for clickable actions that do something on the page.

values.value: links or divs styled as buttons
values.definition: Actions use anchors or non-semantic elements styled to look like buttons.

attributes.name: DOM leanness
attributes.definition: How minimal the page markup and scripting are: node count, script count and class vocabulary size.

values.value: lean DOM with few scripts and small class vocabulary
values.definition: Minimal markup, few scripts, and a small set of custom classes.
Deeply nested markup, many scripts or a large class vocabulary.
